title: RLVR Datasets and Where to Find Them: Tracing Data Lineage for Better Training Data
authors_zh: Hsiu-Yuan Huang、Weijie Liu、Chenming Tang、Sanwoo Lee、Kai Yang、Yangkun Chen、Saiyong Yang、Yunfang Wu
paper_type_zh: RLVR 数据谱系审计与构造配方
best_for_zh: 关注 RLVR 数据来源、污染控制、可学习性归因与开放发布审计的研究者
one_line: ATLAS traces 1.45M RLVR instances to atomic sources and uses leakage and source-utility signals to construct the released 17K-row DAPO++, while the lineage and selection ledgers remain unreleased.
ATLAS 将 145 万条 RLVR 记录追溯到原子来源，并据泄漏与来源效用信号构建公开的 1.7 万条 DAPO++；完整谱系与选择账本尚未发布。
why: It links provenance evidence to an explicit RLVR construction and benchmarking recipe, and shows why a final Parquet cannot support full reuse auditing when atomic-source labels, SCA decisions, random replacement history, licenses, and immutable release metadata are missing.
inclusion_reason: This work makes atomic-source lineage, contamination, source-conditioned learnability, dataset scoring, and lineage-guided DAPO++ construction part of one RLVR data workflow, while its partial release exposes concrete provenance and reproducibility gaps relevant to open-recipe auditing.

title: Problem
问题
html:
RLVR training sets are often named and cited as if each release were an independent source. In practice, prompts pass through nested aggregation, filtering, answer replacement, multiple-choice conversion, and rewriting. Dataset-level attribution cannot show which original collection supplied a record, which transformations it underwent, whether it overlaps an evaluation set, or whether answers remain consistent across copies.

The paper separates two decisions. A lineage audit asks where each canonical question-answer instance first entered the ecosystem and where it reappeared. A training-data audit asks which sources and records supply useful, verifiable, contamination-controlled signal for a particular RLVR model. ATLAS addresses the first decision; Source-level Counterfactual Attribution (SCA), the composite score Q, and DAPO++ address the second.

For this atlas, the central issue is the difference between a public file and an auditable construction recipe. The paper analyzes 1,450,827 instances and reports 20 atomic-source labels, but the repository ships tracing code and a 17,000-row DAPO++ Parquet rather than the complete lineage dictionary, SCA annotations, or selection ledger. The analysis corpus, source-conditioned labels, released training file, and downstream benchmark must therefore be evaluated as separate evidence surfaces.

RLVR 训练集常被命名和引用为彼此独立的来源，但提示可能经历多层聚合、过滤、答案替换、选择题转换和改写。仅有数据集级归属无法说明某条记录最初来自哪个采集源、经历了哪些变换、是否与评测集重叠，也无法确认不同副本的答案是否一致。

论文区分了两个决策。谱系审计追问每个规范化问答实例最初从何处进入生态，随后又出现在哪里；训练数据审计则判断哪些来源和记录能为特定 RLVR 模型提供有用、可验证且受污染控制的信号。ATLAS 处理前者，Source-level Counterfactual Attribution（SCA）、复合分数 Q 与 DAPO++ 处理后者。

对本 atlas 而言，核心问题是“公开文件”与“可审计构造配方”的差别。论文分析 1,450,827 个实例并报告 20 个原子来源标签，但仓库发布的是追溯代码和 17,000 行 DAPO++ Parquet，而非完整谱系字典、SCA 标注或选择账本。因此，分析语料、来源条件标签、公开训练文件与下游基准必须作为不同证据面分别评估。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The contribution is an integrated four-layer workflow rather than a single new dataset. Atomic-source Tracing via Lineage-Aware Search (ATLAS) canonicalizes public RLVR records into final question-answer pairs, indexes exact prompt reuse chronologically with SHA-1, recovers transformed matches through Sentence-BERT retrieval plus author review, and iteratively adds candidate sources. Its intended output is a lineage dictionary with occurrence lists and atomic-source assignments.

SCA treats each atomic source as an intervention unit. For source s, a shared base checkpoint is compared with a checkpoint trained on s. Source instances receive one of four binary-correctness transitions: 00 fails before and after, 01 becomes correct after source-specific RL, 10 degrades, and 11 is correct under both. These are model- and checkpoint-conditioned learnability labels, not immutable labels of mathematical quality.

The score Q combines three dimensions: S1 covers static properties such as answer consistency and verifiability, MCQ and reuse penalties, SCA learnability, diversity, and contamination; S2 uses Math500 Mean@4 as a sampling-efficiency signal; S3 uses Math500 Pass@4 as a capability-boundary signal. Q ranks datasets. It is neither the Math-Verify rollout reward nor a judge that certifies individual rows.

DAPO++ turns the audit into a construction action. Detected leaked rows are removed from DAPO-Math-17k and randomly replaced with non-MCQ Stack Exchange rows labeled learnable by SCA. The repository releases the resulting 17,000-row prompt-and-ground-truth file, but not the complete evidence chain behind every retained or inserted record.

该贡献是一套四层整合工作流，而不是单一新数据集。Atomic-source Tracing via Lineage-Aware Search（ATLAS）把公开 RLVR 记录规范化为最终问答对，按时间用 SHA-1 索引精确提示复用，再以 Sentence-BERT 检索配合作者审查恢复变换后的匹配，并迭代加入候选来源。其预期输出是带出现列表和原子来源归属的谱系字典。

SCA 把每个原子来源视为干预单元。对来源 s，共享 base checkpoint 与在 s 上训练的 checkpoint 进行比较，来源内实例被赋予四类二元正确性转移：00 表示训练前后均失败，01 表示来源特定 RL 后变正确，10 表示退化，11 表示两者都正确。这些是受模型和 checkpoint 条件约束的可学习性标签，不是固定不变的数学质量标签。

分数 Q 组合三个维度：S1 包含答案一致性与可验证性、MCQ 和复用惩罚、SCA 可学习性、多样性与污染等静态属性；S2 用 Math500 Mean@4 表示采样效率；S3 用 Math500 Pass@4 表示能力边界。Q 用于数据集排序，既不是 Math-Verify rollout 奖励，也不是认证单条记录的 judge。

DAPO++ 把审计转化为构造动作：从 DAPO-Math-17k 删除检测到泄漏的记录，再随机加入被 SCA 标为可学习的非 MCQ Stack Exchange 记录。仓库公开最终 17,000 行提示与标准答案文件，但没有公开每条保留或插入记录背后的完整证据链。

title: Method
方法
html:
ATLAS starts from public RLVR datasets and documented predecessors. Because schemas and appended instructions differ, the authors inspect 30–50 records per dataset and manually define extraction into final question-answer pairs. A 40-character SHA-1 prompt key supports chronological exact matching, and the lineage dictionary stores every observed occurrence. Unmatched prompts are embedded with Sentence-BERT, retrieved by cosine similarity, and reviewed case by case. When the unmatched set remains too large, candidate authoritative sources are added and earlier stages rerun. The stopping threshold is 1%; the final residue is labeled unknown. The paper reports 1,450,827 records, 20 atomic-source labels, and fewer than 1% unknown.

Leakage auditing compares the RLVR universe with 14 math evaluation benchmarks. The reported 36,148 high-confidence matches emphasize similarity at or above 0.90, while the paper notes transformed leakage near 0.80. DAPO++ removes detected leakage from DAPO-Math-17k and randomly draws non-MCQ, SCA-01-style learnable replacements from the Stack Exchange atomic source. The seed, eligible-pool revision, exact removed and inserted counts, rejected candidates, and replacement mapping are unknown.

For SCA, a Qwen3 base model and a source-specific GRPO checkpoint form a counterfactual pair. Correctness under the two checkpoints produces 00, 01, 10, or 11 labels. Q combines the resulting learnability feature with answer consistency, MCQ prevalence, cross-dataset reuse, source or domain diversity, confirmed leakage, and Math500 Mean@4 and Pass@4 gains. Because Math500 also selects checkpoints, the score is partly coupled to its validation surface.

RL training uses Qwen3-1.7B-Base and Qwen3-8B-Base, GRPO on VERL, 8 online rollouts per prompt, temperature 1.0, and Math-Verify scalar reward. The paper reports learning rate 1e-6, 500 steps, batch 128, mini-batch 64, KL 0.0, clip 0.2, a 4,096-token prompt limit, and a 16,384-token response limit. Released scripts instead use 510 steps, mini-batch 16, and KL 0.001; the 8B script uses batch 32. Paper-aligned evaluation uses temperature 0.6, seed 0, top_p 0.95, and top_k 20, while training-script validation uses top_p 0.7 and top_k 50.

The released DAPO_Plus.parquet contains 17,000 unique train rows with five top-level fields: data_source, prompt, ability, reward_model, and extra_info. Every row has data_source=DataLineage, ability=math, one user-role prompt, rule-style ground truth, and a dapo-prefixed unique index. It stores no online rollout, atomic source, predecessor, transformation, SCA label, match score, retained-versus-replacement status, selection probability, source URL, or license.

ATLAS 从公开 RLVR 数据集及其文档所列前序来源开始。由于 schema 和附加指令不同，作者从每个数据集检查 30–50 条记录，人工定义最终问答对的提取方式。40 字符 SHA-1 提示键支持按时间精确匹配，谱系字典保存每次出现。未匹配提示由 Sentence-BERT 编码，按余弦相似度检索后逐例审查；若未匹配集合仍过大，就加入候选权威来源并重跑前序阶段。停止阈值为 1%，最终残余标为 unknown。论文报告 1,450,827 条记录、20 个原子来源标签和低于 1% 的 unknown。

泄漏审计将 RLVR 全集与 14 个数学评测基准比较。报告的 36,148 个高置信匹配主要强调不低于 0.90 的相似度，论文同时指出 0.80 附近仍有变换泄漏。DAPO++ 从 DAPO-Math-17k 删除检测到的泄漏，再从 Stack Exchange 原子来源随机抽取非 MCQ、SCA-01 型可学习记录作为替换。随机种子、候选池版本、确切删除与插入数量、被拒候选和替换映射均为 unknown。

在 SCA 中，Qwen3 base 模型与来源特定 GRPO checkpoint 构成反事实对。两个 checkpoint 上的正确性产生 00、01、10 或 11 标签。Q 将该可学习性特征与答案一致性、MCQ 比例、跨数据集复用、来源或领域多样性、已确认泄漏，以及 Math500 Mean@4 和 Pass@4 增益组合。由于 Math500 同时用于 checkpoint 选择，该分数与其验证面部分耦合。

RL 训练使用 Qwen3-1.7B-Base 和 Qwen3-8B-Base，在 VERL 上运行 GRPO；每条提示生成 8 个在线 rollout，温度为 1.0，并以 Math-Verify 产生标量奖励。论文报告学习率 1e-6、500 步、batch 128、mini-batch 64、KL 0.0、clip 0.2、提示上限 4,096 tokens、回答上限 16,384 tokens。公开脚本却使用 510 步、mini-batch 16 和 KL 0.001，8B 脚本使用 batch 32。与论文一致的评测使用温度 0.6、seed 0、top_p 0.95、top_k 20，而训练脚本验证使用 top_p 0.7 和 top_k 50。

公开 DAPO_Plus.parquet 含 17,000 条唯一训练记录，顶层只有 data_source、prompt、ability、reward_model 和 extra_info 五个字段。所有记录的 data_source 均为 DataLineage、ability 均为 math；每条包含一个 user-role 提示、rule 风格标准答案和一个带 dapo 前缀的唯一索引。它不保存在线 rollout、原子来源、前序记录、变换、SCA 标签、匹配分数、保留或替换状态、选择概率、来源 URL 或许可证。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The lineage result is broad but paper-mediated. The paper reports 1,450,827 canonical instances, 20 atomic-source labels, more than 99.7% attributed, and 36,148 high-confidence leaked instances against 14 math benchmarks. The repository supplies canonicalizers and exact and semantic matching scripts, but not the final lineage dictionary, occurrence lists, source assignments, embeddings, match matrices, or author decisions needed to recompute the aggregates independently.

The downstream RLVR results support a within-study comparison. Excluding Math500 from Average, DAPO++ scores 15.7 versus 15.0 for decontaminated DAPO with Qwen3-1.7B and 29.6 versus 29.3 with Qwen3-8B. Decontamination ablations raise Average from 14.1 to 14.7 for DeepScaleR-1.7B, 14.6 to 15.0 for DAPO-1.7B, 24.4 to 26.1 for DeepScaleR-8B, and 29.4 to 29.6 for DAPO-8B. These results do not establish that each released row is correct, uncontaminated, licensed, or causally useful.

Q is evaluated on six datasets. Its Spearman correlation with Average is 0.60 at 1.7B and 0.94 at 8B, while cross-dataset Average standard deviation is 0.59 and 2.17. Q uses Math500-derived features, and Math500 also selects checkpoints. The stronger 8B association is therefore evidence for a scale- and benchmark-conditioned ranking proxy, not universal data quality or an independent verifier.

The released file can be checked directly. At commit d048f53f7b7ab53b2b82f5e8d5f6323333e5e0c4, DAPO_Plus.parquet is 3,507,245 bytes with SHA-256 3e6ecc481b4e9f51a53d210b27bff14fd9f12744ee88f5a40910f9ef0d68a2ab, 17,000 rows, 5 columns, 17,000 unique prompts and indices, one train split, one data_source value, one ability value, and 2,392 distinct ground-truth strings. It has no record-level lineage or SCA field. An otherwise English prompt contains a stray Chinese instruction marker; this is a mixed-language or text-noise observation, not evidence of byte-level encoding corruption.

The code release is not an end-to-end reproduction package. Benchmark_Scoring/analyze_features.py requires an unreleased stage4_final.json and stops after 800,000 entries; compute_scores.py hard-codes feature and Math500 summaries. Paper Table 9 and the GRPO scripts also disagree on steps, mini-batch, KL, batch size, and evaluation settings. File existence and benchmark movement therefore do not verify the claimed selection history.

谱系结果覆盖面广，但目前主要由论文转述。论文报告 1,450,827 个规范化实例、20 个原子来源标签、超过 99.7% 已归属，以及相对 14 个数学基准的 36,148 个高置信泄漏实例。仓库虽提供规范化、精确匹配和语义匹配脚本，却没有最终谱系字典、出现列表、来源归属、embedding、匹配矩阵或作者决策，因此无法独立重算聚合结果。

下游 RLVR 结果支持研究内部比较。Average* 排除 Math500 后，DAPO++ 在 Qwen3-1.7B 上为 15.7，去污染 DAPO 为 15.0；在 Qwen3-8B 上分别为 29.6 和 29.3。去污染消融中，DeepScaleR-1.7B 从 14.1 升至 14.7，DAPO-1.7B 从 14.6 升至 15.0，DeepScaleR-8B 从 24.4 升至 26.1，DAPO-8B 从 29.4 升至 29.6。这些结果不能证明每条公开记录都正确、无污染、许可清晰或具有因果收益。

Q 仅在六个数据集上评估。它与 Average 的 Spearman 相关在 1.7B 为 0.60、8B 为 0.94，而跨数据集 Average 标准差分别为 0.59 和 2.17。Q 使用 Math500 派生特征，Math500 又用于 checkpoint 选择。因此，更强的 8B 相关性支持的是受规模与基准条件约束的排序代理，而非通用数据质量或独立 verifier。

公开文件可以直接核验。在 commit d048f53f7b7ab53b2b82f5e8d5f6323333e5e0c4，DAPO_Plus.parquet 大小为 3,507,245 bytes，SHA-256 为 3e6ecc481b4e9f51a53d210b27bff14fd9f12744ee88f5a40910f9ef0d68a2ab；包含 17,000 行、5 列、17,000 个唯一提示和索引、一个 train split、一个 data_source 值、一个 ability 值，以及 2,392 个不同标准答案字符串。文件没有逐记录谱系或 SCA 字段。一个原本为英文的提示含有孤立的中文指令标记；这是混合语言或文本噪声观察，不是字节级编码损坏的证据。

当前代码并非端到端复现包。Benchmark_Scoring/analyze_features.py 依赖未发布的 stage4_final.json，并在 800,000 条后停止；compute_scores.py 硬编码特征与 Math500 汇总。论文表 9 与 GRPO 脚本还在步数、mini-batch、KL、batch size 和评测设置上冲突。因此，文件存在与 benchmark 变化不能验证所声称的选择历史。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The closest baseline is ordinary dataset-level lineage, where a release cites only its direct predecessor and repeated prompts or older sources disappear behind aggregation. ATLAS changes the audit unit to canonical prompts with chronological occurrence lists and atomic-source labels. Combining exact reuse, semantic recovery, and iterative source expansion at 1.45M-instance scale makes lineage an input to construction rather than only a literature description.

SCA adds a source-conditioned utility view. A base checkpoint and a source-trained checkpoint define correctness transitions that are transferred to records from that source. This is more operational than ranking sources by size or one final benchmark score, but it remains conditioned on model scale, checkpoint, verifier, and training recipe and does not identify the causal contribution of one row.

Q and DAPO++ connect audit to action. Q separates static properties from dynamic RLVR utility, and DAPO++ uses leakage and learnability decisions to repair an existing 17K-prompt set. For data_construction_open_release_recipes, the useful direction is the linkage among lineage, selection rules, replacement, reward, and evaluation.

SHA-1 matching, Sentence-BERT retrieval, manual review, GRPO, VERL, Math-Verify, DAPO-Math-17k, Stack Exchange problems, Mean@N, and Pass@N are not new contributions. The release also does not establish a new provenance-completeness standard because its final lineage, SCA, removal, and replacement ledgers are absent. The novelty is the integrated RLVR workflow and source-conditioned framing, not a new mathematical verifier or proof that benchmark gains certify data quality.

最接近的基线是普通数据集级谱系：一个发布只引用直接前序，重复提示和更早来源被聚合过程遮蔽。ATLAS 将审计单元改为带时间顺序出现列表和原子来源标签的规范化提示。在 1.45M 实例规模上组合精确复用、语义恢复与迭代来源扩展，使谱系成为构造输入，而不仅是文献描述。

SCA 增加了来源条件化效用视角。base checkpoint 与来源训练 checkpoint 定义正确性转移，再将其赋给该来源记录。这比按来源规模或单一最终 benchmark 分数排序更具操作性，但仍受模型规模、checkpoint、verifier 和训练配方约束，也不能识别单条记录的因果贡献。

Q 与 DAPO++ 把审计连接到行动。Q 区分静态属性和动态 RLVR 效用，DAPO++ 则用泄漏与可学习性决策修复一个已有 17K 提示集。对 data_construction_open_release_recipes 而言，谱系、选择规则、替换、奖励与评测之间的连接是最有价值的方向信号。

SHA-1 匹配、Sentence-BERT 检索、人工审查、GRPO、VERL、Math-Verify、DAPO-Math-17k、Stack Exchange 题目、Mean@N 和 Pass@N 均不是新贡献。由于最终谱系、SCA、删除和替换账本缺失，该发布也没有建立新的 provenance 完整性标准。其新意是整合式 RLVR 工作流与来源条件化视角，而不是新的数学 verifier，也不是用 benchmark 增益认证数据质量。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• The complete 1,450,827-instance lineage dictionary, occurrence lists, source labels, transformations, match scores, and author decisions are absent, so aggregate lineage and leakage claims cannot be audited record by record.
  • DAPO++ does not identify retained DAPO versus inserted Stack Exchange rows. Atomic source, upstream record and revision, predecessor chain, transformation, removal reason, SCA transition, source URL, and license are unknown per row.
  • Random replacement cannot be replayed because the seed, eligible-pool snapshot, exact removal and insertion counts, rejected candidates, and old-to-new mapping are unknown; the final 17,000-row file is insufficient.
  • SCA labels are conditioned on one base/source checkpoint pair. They are not stable truth labels, individual causal effects, or guarantees for another model scale, verifier, optimizer, or prompt format.
  • Q uses Math500 Mean@4 and Pass@4 while Math500 also selects checkpoints. Correlations cover six datasets, and external validity beyond two Qwen3 scales and this math surface is unknown.
  • The 36,148 leakage count emphasizes similarity at or above 0.90 and acknowledges risk near 0.80. Rewrites below threshold, benchmark-version drift, and manual false positives or negatives remain unresolved.
  • Manual canonicalization inspects only 30–50 records per dataset, and semantic ancestry is reviewed case by case. No inter-annotator agreement, independent adjudication, sampling-error analysis, or correction protocol is reported; older branches reach only approximately 2014.
  • Released scoring code requires absent stage4_final.json or hard-codes paper results; one script stops at 800,000 entries. GRPO scripts conflict with paper settings.
  • No LICENSE file or tagged immutable release was found. Upstream licensing, generated-output rights, benchmark terms, vendored VERL compatibility, consent, attribution, and deletion handling are unknown.
  • DAPO++ has only a train split, constant data_source, dapo-prefixed indices, and no text-quality report. A sampled prompt has a stray Chinese instruction marker, but broader noise, parser failures, and correction history are uncharacterized.
  • Experiments cover offline mathematical RLVR with Qwen3-1.7B-Base and Qwen3-8B-Base. Code, agent, multimodal, interactive, non-mathematical, and other-model-family uses are not validated.

• 完整的 1,450,827 实例谱系字典、出现列表、来源标签、变换、匹配分数和作者决策均缺失，因而无法逐记录审计谱系与泄漏聚合结论。
  • DAPO++ 不标明记录是从 DAPO 保留还是由 Stack Exchange 插入。逐记录的原子来源、上游记录与版本、前序链、变换、删除原因、SCA 转移、来源 URL 和许可证均为 unknown。
  • 随机替换无法重放，因为随机种子、候选池快照、确切删除与插入数量、被拒候选和新旧映射均为 unknown；最终 17,000 行文件并不足够。
  • SCA 标签受一个 base/来源 checkpoint 对约束。它们不是稳定真值、单条因果效应，也不能保证对其他模型规模、verifier、优化器或提示格式成立。
  • Q 使用 Math500 Mean@4 与 Pass@4，而 Math500 同时用于 checkpoint 选择。相关性只覆盖六个数据集，对两个 Qwen3 规模与该数学评测面之外的外部有效性为 unknown。
  • 36,148 条泄漏统计强调不低于 0.90 的相似度，并承认 0.80 附近仍有风险。阈值以下改写、基准版本漂移及人工误报漏报仍未解决。
  • 人工规范化每个数据集只检查 30–50 条记录，语义祖先又逐例审查。论文没有报告标注者一致性、独立裁决、抽样误差或纠错协议；较早分支仅恢复到约 2014 年。
  • 公开评分代码依赖缺失的 stage4_final.json 或硬编码论文结果，其中一个脚本在 800,000 条后停止。GRPO 脚本也与论文设置冲突。
  • 未发现 LICENSE 文件或带标签的不可变发布。上游许可、生成输出权利、基准条款、内置 VERL 兼容性、同意、归属和删除处理均为 unknown。
  • DAPO++ 只有 train split、常量 data_source、dapo 前缀索引，且无文本质量报告。一条抽查提示含孤立中文指令标记，但更广泛噪声、parser 失败和纠错历史未被刻画。
  • 实验仅覆盖 Qwen3-1.7B-Base 与 Qwen3-8B-Base 上的离线数学 RLVR；代码、agent、多模态、交互式、非数学和其他模型家族用途均未验证。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For data_construction_open_release_recipes, the work decomposes an RLVR data pipeline into explicit audit points: normalize records, group exact reuse, recover transformed ancestry, preserve chronological occurrences, audit evaluation overlap, estimate source-conditioned learnability, define a dataset-level score, repair a training set, and evaluate the repair under a fixed reward and optimizer. Its main reusable lesson is that provenance, verification, selection, and evaluation should be connected by records rather than summarized only at dataset level.

A reusable lineage record should retain canonical prompt and answer hashes, upstream IDs and revisions, source URLs, timestamps, every occurrence, transformation type, exact and semantic match scores, candidate ancestors, final source decision, reviewer and adjudication, uncertainty, and license. The final lineage dictionary is necessary to audit the reported 1.45M-instance map.

A reusable SCA and Q record should retain base and source checkpoint revisions, the source training subset, GRPO settings, Math-Verify and parser versions, rollout seeds, per-checkpoint correctness, the 00/01/10/11 label, aggregation weights, diversity and contamination features, the Math500 checkpoint-selection trace, and every Q input. These scores should be recomputed when the model, verifier, parser, mixture, or evaluation revision changes.

A reusable DAPO++ decision ledger should preserve every original DAPO row, leakage evidence, keep-or-remove decision, complete eligible replacement pool, random seed and draw order, rejected candidates, selected Stack Exchange row, MCQ and SCA gates, final row ID, transformation, source license, and immutable checksum. The public Parquet is useful as a rule-reward prompt schema and as the exact 17,000-row training object at the verified commit, but it cannot explain why each record entered the set.

Metric contracts must remain separate: Math-Verify is the rollout reward; SCA is a checkpoint-conditioned learnability proxy; Q is a six-dataset ranking score; SRank is an aggregate reference ranking; Average* is downstream evaluation excluding Math500. Benchmark improvement is not proof that released data are correct, uncontaminated, licensed, or generally high quality.

对 data_construction_open_release_recipes 而言，该工作把 RLVR 数据流水线拆成明确审计点：规范化记录、归并精确复用、恢复变换后的祖先、保留按时间排序的出现、审计评测重叠、估计来源条件化可学习性、定义数据集级分数、修复训练集，再在固定奖励与优化器下评测修复结果。最可复用的经验是用显式记录连接 provenance、verification、selection 与 evaluation，而不是只做数据集级摘要。

可复用谱系记录应保留规范化提示与答案 hash、上游 ID 与版本、来源 URL、时间戳、每次出现、变换类型、精确与语义匹配分数、候选祖先、最终来源决策、审查与裁决、不确定性和许可证。要审计论文报告的 1.45M 实例映射，仍需最终谱系字典。

可复用 SCA 与 Q 记录应保留 base 和来源 checkpoint 版本、来源训练子集、GRPO 设置、Math-Verify 与 parser 版本、rollout seeds、各 checkpoint 正确性、00/01/10/11 标签、聚合权重、多样性与污染特征、Math500 checkpoint 选择轨迹和每个 Q 输入。只要模型、verifier、parser、混合或评测版本改变，就应重新计算这些分数。

可复用 DAPO++ 决策账本应保留每条原始 DAPO 记录、泄漏证据、保留或删除决策、完整可选替换池、随机种子与抽取顺序、被拒候选、选中的 Stack Exchange 记录、MCQ 与 SCA 门控、最终行 ID、变换、来源许可证和不可变 checksum。公开 Parquet 可作为 rule-reward 提示 schema，也可作为已核验 commit 的精确 17,000 行训练对象，但无法解释每条记录为何进入集合。

指标契约必须分开：Math-Verify 是 rollout 奖励；SCA 是受 checkpoint 约束的可学习性代理；Q 是六数据集排序分数；SRank 是聚合参考排序；Average* 是排除 Math500 的下游评测。benchmark 提升不是公开数据正确、无污染、许可清晰或普遍高质量的证明。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Keep five objects separate: the 1,450,827-instance ATLAS lineage analysis, source-conditioned SCA labels, composite score Q, 17,000-row DAPO++ release, and downstream RLVR benchmark.
  • ATLAS reports 20 atomic-source labels and more than 99.7% attribution, but the complete dictionary, occurrence lists, match outputs, and author decisions are not released.
  • SCA's 00/01/10/11 transition is conditioned on one base/source checkpoint pair; it is neither a permanent correctness label nor an individual causal estimate.
  • DAPO++ replaces detected leaked DAPO rows with eligible Stack Exchange rows, but the random seed, exact counts, candidate pool, rejected rows, and mapping are unknown.
  • Q's Spearman correlations of 0.60 and 0.94 use six datasets and Math500-derived features; interpret them as within-study ranking evidence, not proof of data quality.
  • The Parquet verifies 17,000 unique train prompts and a rule-reward schema, but has no record-level atomic source, SCA, transformation, selection, license, or retained-versus-replacement fields. Reproduction also requires resolving paper-script conflicts and obtaining the missing stage4 lineage input.

• 区分五个对象：1,450,827 实例 ATLAS 谱系分析、来源条件化 SCA 标签、复合分数 Q、17,000 行 DAPO++ 发布和下游 RLVR benchmark。
  • ATLAS 报告 20 个原子来源标签和超过 99.7% 的归属率，但完整字典、出现列表、匹配输出与作者决策没有公开。
  • SCA 的 00/01/10/11 转移受一个 base/来源 checkpoint 对约束；它既不是永久正确性标签，也不是单条因果估计。
  • DAPO++ 用合格 Stack Exchange 记录替换检测到泄漏的 DAPO 记录，但随机种子、确切数量、候选池、被拒记录和映射均为 unknown。
  • Q 的 0.60 与 0.94 Spearman 相关只使用六个数据集和 Math500 派生特征，应理解为研究内部排序证据，而非数据质量证明。
  • Parquet 可核验 17,000 条唯一训练提示和 rule-reward schema，但没有逐记录原子来源、SCA、变换、选择、许可证或保留与替换字段。复现还需解决论文与脚本冲突，并取得缺失的 stage4 谱系输入。
